The main concerns are the page count potentially exceeding limits, incremental novelty given concurrent work, and limited practical applicability since it only works with base models and shows negative downstream results. I should also flag that DDR's distinction from known distributional shift phenomena isn't clear enough, the cross-model chain F1 might be confounded by generator identity, and the task formulation contribution is fairly straightforward. There are also minor issues like the abstract being slightly short and some redundant statistical measures.

On the positive side, the experimental design is meticulous with strong controls, the authors honestly report negative results and limitations, the writing is clean and well-organized, citations are comprehensive, and they've committed to reproducibility. Now I'll draft the formal review.
